description: This source file defines the singleton object WebViewTvUtils that provides a method to configure WebView instances with settings optimized for Android TV, including enabling JavaScript, DOM storage, safe browsing, and focus behavior adjustments.

classes.name: WebViewTvUtils
classes.description: A singleton object providing a configured setup for WebView tailored for Android TV.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the provided WebView instance with settings optimized for Android TV, including enabling JavaScript, DOM storage, overview mode, disabling controls, enabling safe browsing on API level 26+, and focus properties.
